description: The dialect crate's build-time seed: gen dialect emits a build.rs that copies the canonical dialect's contributing documents from the sibling path ../../kdl/schemas/dialect into OUT_DIR, naming each document in contribution order, and compile.rs includes each through an OUT_DIR include_str! beside the CANONICAL_VERSION constant naming the version the documents declare — the crate commits no copy, so the embed cannot drift from the canonical documents. Building the generated crate in a scratch workspace that holds no canonical documents fails closed: cargo exits nonzero and the build script's panic names the missing document and that the crate builds only from a kdlith checkout

command: grep -E '^const (CANONICAL_DIR|DOCUMENTS)' ws/rs/demo/build.rs; grep -o 'include_str!(concat!(env!("OUT_DIR"), "/schema/[a-z]*\.kdl"))' ws/rs/demo/src/compile.rs; grep 'pub const CANONICAL_VERSION' ws/rs/demo/src/compile.rs; test ! -e ws/rs/demo/src/dialect && echo no-snapshot
if cargo build --offline --manifest-path ws/rs/demo/Cargo.toml 2> build.err; then echo 'built without the canonical documents'; exit 1; fi

stdout-contains: ; build this crate from a kdlith checkout
